name: koci-atcommands
author: syfqpie
description: Player @commands for everyone, each switchable in Settings.

settings.label: Character: Raise your base level (@baselevelup)
settings.description: Raises your base level the desired number of levels.

settings.label: Character: Raise your job level (@joblevelup)
settings.description: Raises your job level the desired number of levels.

settings.label: Character: Change job (@jobchange)
settings.description: Changes your job.

settings.label: Character: Get all skills (@allskill)
settings.description: Gives you all skills.

settings.label: Character: List character commands (@charcommands)
settings.description: Displays a list of charcommands that you can use.

settings.label: Stats: Raise STR (@str)
settings.description: Raises STR by given amount.

settings.label: Stats: Raise AGI (@agi)
settings.description: Raises AGI by given amount.

settings.label: Stats: Raise VIT (@vit)
settings.description: Raises VIT by given amount.

settings.label: Stats: Raise INT (@int)
settings.description: Raises INT by given amount.

settings.label: Stats: Raise DEX (@dex)
settings.description: Raises DEX by given amount.

settings.label: Stats: Raise LUK (@luk)
settings.description: Raises LUK by given amount.

settings.label: Stats: Raise POW (@pow)
settings.description: Raises POW by given amount.

settings.label: Stats: Raise STA (@sta)
settings.description: Raises STA by given amount.

settings.label: Stats: Raise SPL (@spl)
settings.description: Raises SPL by given amount.

settings.label: Stats: Raise CON (@con)
settings.description: Raises CON by given amount.

settings.label: Stats: Raise CRT (@crt)
settings.description: Raises CRT by given amount.

settings.label: Items: Spawn an item (@item)
settings.description: Gives you the desired item.

settings.label: Items: Refine equipment (@refine)
settings.description: Refines the equipment in a given position by a +/- amount.

settings.label: Items: Grade equipment (@grade)
settings.description: Changes the grade of the equipment in a given position by a +/- amount.

settings.label: Items: Change costume (@costume)
settings.description: Changes the player's visible appearance to the selected costume.

settings.label: Economy: Get Zeny (@zeny)
settings.description: Gives you the desired amount of Zeny.

settings.label: Economy: Get cash points (@cash)
settings.description: Gives you the specified amount of cash points.

settings.label: Economy: Get Kafra points (@points)
settings.description: Gives you the specified amount of Kafra Points.

settings.label: Loot: Autoloot (@autoloot)
settings.description: Makes items go straight into your inventory.

settings.label: Loot: Autoloot by item (@autolootitem)
settings.description: Makes items of specific item IDs go straight into your inventory.

settings.label: Monsters: Spawn a monster (@monster)
settings.description: Spawns the desired monster.

settings.label: Monsters: Find a monster on this map (@mobsearch)
settings.description: Shows the location of a certain monster on the current map.

settings.label: Monsters: Where a monster spawns (@whereis)
settings.description: Displays the maps in which a monster normally spawns.

settings.label: Monsters: Who drops an item (@whodrops)
settings.description: Shows who drops an item (monster with highest drop rates).

settings.label: Pets & Homunculus: Hatch a pet egg (@hatch)
settings.description: Creates a pet from your inventory eggs list.

settings.label: Pets & Homunculus: Evolve homunculus (@homevolution)
settings.description: Evolves your homunculus, if possible.

settings.label: Pets & Homunculus: Set homunculus intimacy (@homfriendly)
settings.description: Sets your homunculus intimacy level to the desired value (0-1000).

settings.label: Pets & Homunculus: Show homunculus stats (@hominfo)
settings.description: Displays homunculus stats.

settings.label: Pets & Homunculus: Raise homunculus level (@homlevel)
settings.description: Increases the homunculus level by the given amount.

settings.label: Mounts: Cart (@cart)
settings.description: Gives or removes a cart and changes the cart skin.

settings.label: Mounts: Job mount (@mount_peco)
settings.description: Gives or removes a job-based mount.

settings.label: Guild: Create a guild (@guild)
settings.description: Creates a guild.

settings.label: Guild: Raise guild level (@guildlevelup)
settings.description: Raises your guild by the desired number of levels.
